<$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,659)><$voicel(3,9)><$cdef(27)>! Let’s get the venue vibin’ and
raise
the
<$cdef(27)>mood, yo!
<$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,805)><$voicel(3,7)>You can leave the music to me!
<$comeff(3,6)><$motion(3,666)><$voicel(3,5)>So, uh, real quick—do you know what <$cdef(27)>CDs </color>are?

<$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,7)><$cdef(27)>CDs are things the humans made to record their music on
for playback purposes, yo!

<$comeff(3,12)><$motion(3,665)><$voicel(3,9)>Yooo! You know what they are! NICE!
<$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,7)>Yep! They’re those flat things that humans made to record
music for playback purposes!

<$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,807)><$voicel(3,7)>If you put some <$cdef(27)>CDs in my CD player, I can play the
music that’s been recorded on ’em!
<$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,801)><$voicel(3,9)>The more <$cdef(27)>CDs we’ve got, the more music we can add
to our rotation! <$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,10)>Isn’t that AWESOME?

<$comeff(3,5)><$motion(3,659)><$voicel(3,9)>So anyway, <$cdef(27)>, I guess first I’m
gonna
need
you
to go
out
and
find
us
some <$cdef(27)>CDs!
<$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,806)><$voicel(3,7)>Once you’ve got ’em, just put ’em in my CD player, yo!

<$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,801)><$voicel(3,7)>First, I’m gonna need you to go out and find us some
<$cdef(27)>CDs, <$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,9)>Once you’ve got ’em, just put ’em in my CD player, yo!

<$comeff(3,7)><$motion(3,667)><$voicel(3,3)>What? You don’t know where to find any <$cdef(27)>CDs? Yeah, that’s
kinda a problem, huh...

<$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,7)>I heard it was, like...a REAL long time ago that the humans
were usin’ <$cdef(27)>CDs, so...
<$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,805)><$voicel(3,5)>Maybe you could find ’em buried in the ground or
somethin’?

<$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,8)>Woo-hoooo! Music’s the BEST, yo!
<$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,659)><$voicel(3,9)>This body of mine plays real “clear and immersive sound”!
That’s, like, in my specs or whatever!

<$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,801)><$voicel(3,7)>Yooo! Glad you like it, <$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(3,5)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,9)>Oh, by the way, I can hold up to <$cdef(27)>five <$cdef(27)>CDs in this fancy
body of mine!
<$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,807)><$voicel(3,7)>Bring me any new <$cdef(27)>CDs you find! I’d be happy to hold on to
’em for you!

<$comeff(3,21)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,7)>Yooo, I get to listen to new music, and it’s all thanks
to you, <$cdef(27)>. <$comeff(3,9)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,10)>This is AWESOME!

<$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,801)><$voicel(3,7)>But we’re gonna need somethin’ else with the music to get
the <$cdef(27)>mood just right and the venue vibin’...
<$comeff(3,5)><$motion(3,805)><$voicel(3,9)>I’m thinkin’ we need a Pokémon who’s high-key down to
party—one who can give us a primo dance performance!

<$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,5)>So I guess the next thing I’d like your help with is bringin’
a Pokémon over who can really <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(14)> a crowd!
<$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,7)>Bring ’em right here next to me, yo!
<$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,806)><$voicel(3,9)>I’m sure they’ll give us a sick performance as soon as
they catch my musical vibes!

<$comeff(3,20)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,5)>Someone like...hmmm... I bet <$cdef(27)>Ludicolo would be a great
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(14)> Pokémon!
<$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,666)><$voicel(3,6)>Somethin’ about ’em just makes me think that, y’know?!

Find a Pokémon with the <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(14)> specialty and bring
them back here.

while
the
music
is

on
a

<$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,7)>I need you to bring over a Pokémon who can really
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(14)> a crowd! Right here next to me, yo!

<$comeff(3,9)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,806)><$voicel(3,9)>Someone like...hmmm... I bet <$cdef(27)>Ludicolo would be a sick
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(14)> Pokémon!

find a Pokémon with the <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(14)> specialty!

If you bring them near <$cdef(27)><$cname;0(274)> while music is
playing, they’ll help improve the <$cdef(27)>mood!

<$comeff(3,9)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,659)><$voicel(3,9)>Yoooooo! What a show! You’re the best <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(14)>
Pokémon there IS!

<$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,801)><$voicel(3,7)>And thank you, too, <$cdef(27)>! The
<$cdef(27)>mood’s
gettin’
pretty AWESOME!

<$comeff(3,3)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,806)><$voicel(3,9)>Now we just gotta get a bunch more Pokémon dancin’
so the vibes get EVEN BETTER!
